race.description: Level One Wine Bar & Cellars Mdn Plate
race.comment: COOL IDOL (12) made a move before the turn and looked a chance but found one better on debut last start over this course and distance. Plenty to like about that performance and with a little improvement she can take this out. SPY TRADER (5) stepped up to 1400m for the first time last start and did a good job to work home into second at the Sapphire Coast. Draws a perfect gate and should be at his peak at the fourth run of the preparation. OLE DANSKER (11) tackled a modest maiden on debut last start over 1300m at Mildura and did a reasonable job to clock in third. Will find this a bit tougher but she can improve with the race experience now on board. GOLD DECREE (3) chalked up his fifth career minor placing recently when third over 1300m at Corowa. In the money at all four runs over today's trip which is a compelling stat. LULL US AWAY (10) is still trying to win one after 9 attempts. Bobs up occasionally so worth including in exotics. Expect a better run from LEI (9) in this company.
